title: Cache enumeration missing
why: Cache visibility is currently grouped under cpu.feature_consistency; a separate key would distinguish absent descriptor/cache leaves.

title: Monotonic timer resolution
why: Resolution increments are currently grouped under timing.tsc_stability despite requiring no TSC.

title: Software breakpoint bytes at own code entries
why: Currently grouped under debugger.exception_tricks even though it reads bytes without triggering an exception.

title: IAT/EAT redirection
why: Currently grouped under instrumentation.module_integrity; import target and export table changes deserve separate coverage accounting.

title: Hyper-V/Viridian enlightenment interface exposed
why: The Hv#1 interface signature and enlightenment leaves are currently grouped under cpu.hypervisor_leaf_range; they are fixed by a different setting (viridian=0 / hv_* flags) than relocated vendor leaves, so the planner should rank them separately.
